policy: source-first; license and dependency verification required; projects are optional services/libraries, not silently copied into the kernel

integration_contract.kernel: no third-party Apache runtime linked into Koronos
integration_contract.userland: sandboxed services with IPC, capabilities and resource quotas
integration_contract.source: upstream source URL, version, license, checksum and build recipe required
integration_contract.database: adapters expose SQL/CDC/object/event interfaces to Nucleus
